calibration._comment: Points at the output of 'porosimeter.py calibrate'. Inline alternative: {"R": 19836.0, "Vr_cm3": 10.9175, "V_LIN_cm3": 0.061402}.

uncertainties._comment: Standard (1-sigma) uncertainties of the raw inputs, used to report each result as value +/- u: pressure readings in meter counts, dry mass, caliper dimensions. Override per sample with the same key inside a sample. u(Vr)/u(V_LIN) are taken from the calibration result file.

samples._comment: core_holder (required): P_DV = the selected spacer discs alone in the holder, P1 = the same discs, undisturbed, with the core added. Expect P1 > P_DV. bulk_volume (required): caliper dimensions or {"value_cm3": ...}. dry_mass_g (optional): used for the bulk density.
